say:1:1330929001:1.text: That's great. However, we need to get rid of all the Hypogean minions first before starting the funeral preparations.
say:1:1330929001:1.source_cn: 那就好。不过葬礼的筹备尚未开始，需要等卫队将公国境内的...

say:2:1330929002:1.text: I want the Archduke and the princess to have their farewell in peace, undisturbed by those Hypogeans...
say:2:1330929002:1.source_cn: 希望大公阁下和公主殿下能不受恶魔干扰，宁静地走完最后一程……
